search_text: published ZDI-20-771 ZDI-CAN-9727 (0Day) CentOS Web Panel ajax_new_account domain SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2020-06-25 CVE-2020-15624 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-15624 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['CentOS Web Panel'] ['CentOS Web Panel'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of CentOS Web Panel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within ajax_new_account.php. When parsing the domain parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root.
